fig1: Figure 1: NEAR/USDT daily closes over 500 days with 50- and 200-day moving averages. Event lines mark the fee switch ramp, buyback wallet creation, the Bitwise NRR ETF launch, and the HSP-029 vote. Source: Binance data-api (data-api.binance.vision), retrieved 2026-11-12.
fig2: Figure 2: NEAR Intents daily volume (gray) and 30-day moving average (teal). All-time $37.4B; 30-day average $124M/day. Source: DefiLlama summary/dexs/near-intents, retrieved 2026-11-12.
fig3: Figure 3: Monthly gross Intents fees (gray bars), net protocol revenue (teal bars), and capture rate (line, right axis). October 2026: $6.39M gross, $2.50M net, 39.2% captured. Sources: DefiLlama; revenue.near.org, retrieved 2026-11-12.
fig4: Figure 4: NEAR L1 daily transactions (left) and daily active accounts (right), 400 days to 11 Nov 2026. Transactions -83% YoY; active accounts -67% YoY. Source: NearBlocks /v1/charts, retrieved 2026-11-12.
fig5: Figure 5: NEAR chain TVL and stablecoin circulating, two years to 12 Nov 2026. TVL $166M (+43% YoY); stablecoins $131M (79% of TVL). Source: DefiLlama historicalChainTvl and stablecoins.llama.fi, retrieved 2026-11-12.
fig6: Figure 6: Net protocol revenue as a percentage of token emissions, monthly since the fee switch. September 2026 peak: 25.2%; November 2026 to date: 17.5%. The 100% line is the deflation threshold. Source: revenue.near.org (on-chain derived), retrieved 2026-11-12.
fig7: Figure 7: The deflation threshold model. The teal line is NEAR removed per day via revenue at the measured net take rate (5.22 bps); dashed lines are the mint at 2.5% and at the 1.6% HSP-029 target. V* is $641M/day at 2.5% and $410M/day at 1.6% (3.3x current volume). Sources: DefiLlama, NEAR RPC, CoinPaprika, revenue.near.org; retrieved 2026-11-12.
fig8: Figure 8: Market cap versus annualized fees (log-log), 12 Nov 2026. NEAR (diamond) sits below the peer pack on gross fees; the peer median multiple is 428x. Sources: DefiLlama, CoinPaprika; retrieved 2026-11-12.
fig9: Figure 9: Cross-correlation of daily NEAR price returns versus Intents volume growth, lags -14 to +14 days (positive lag = volume leads). r = 0.01 at lag 0; max |r| = 0.07 at lag -14. No exploitable timing relationship. Sources: Binance data-api, DefiLlama; retrieved 2026-11-12.
